status: Final native desktop, tablet and phone comparison completed; reference fidelity and honest variant-art limits recorded

book.observedBaselineProblem: A generic dialog style gives champion-catalog a more specific opaque paper background than atlas-book's transparent background. The rectangular catalog surface covers the curved native leaves and the central fold, leaving an apparently flat white object inside a decorative outline.
referenceFeatures: Continuous warm paper material across each bowed leaf, with a narrow recessed center valley.
Separate leather cover, layered page edges, restrained gold corner ornament, external tabs and planning bookmark.
implementation: Scoped transparent surface ownership overrides the generic dialog card background on the catalog and its leaf/layout layers. Individual controls, ingredient cards and selection highlights retain their intended surfaces.
A versioned native SVG owns the full paper silhouette, deeper curved fold, fine paper fibres, edge shadows, bowed head and tail, leather cover and page stack.
Inner content margins reserve space for the center valley. Decorations do not clip controls or intercept pointer input.

atlas.observedBaselineProblem: The plain rectangular report has a large textual legend, weak paper ornament and a text-heavy profile. The compact variant cards read as small cards beside the portrait rather than an illustrated field-guide comparison.
referenceFeatures: Fine ornate parchment perimeter, large serif title, compact numbered index and clear centered wave heading.
A horizontal row of real shared statistics with large visual symbols, followed by broad illustrated trait panels.
implementation: A new native parchment SVG supplies layered irregular edges, fine fibres and larger corner ornament; the report keeps a native vertical scroll container.
The wave-index legend is removed from markup. Current, selected and boss markers and accessible button names remain.

Shared count, movement, health, armor and speed are separate semantic statistic cells, each drawn from the existing configured comparison model. Values that differ stay inside their own variant panel.
Stronger serif headings, body copy and symbols establish the reference hierarchy. Real variant panels have more space; expanded lore follows the full multi-variant comparison.
The existing FRONT image is rendered once per campaign identity. A single-form wave keeps its lore beside the portrait and does not create an empty variant panel.

checks.diffWhitespace: Passed; existing line-ending normalization notices only

renderedObservations: The desktop and iPad-sized book captures visibly expose continuous warm paper across the bowed leaves and a recessed center crease. The opaque rectangular catalog overlay present in 0.4.3 is absent.

Desktop capture 06 showed the footer label touching a curved native paper rule. Both leaf footers received 8 pixels of extra bottom clearance after that review. The source change is included in the final local validation.

The atlas captures show an ornate parchment perimeter, larger serif headings, a horizontal statistic/symbol row and separate named variant panels. Wave 31 uses one approved portrait and expanded full-width lore; wave 44 has one portrait beside lore without an empty variant panel.

Capture 07 is scrolled into its wave report, so it does not show the first wave-index row. Capture 08 shows the complete desktop index. Neither image alone certifies all report/index scroll positions.

The iPad-sized capture 09 exposed a third index row containing only wave 50. The fixed 25-column breakpoint was lowered to 1101 pixels. The release owner subsequently measured 50 buttons in 25 columns and two rows and repeated the final test/build gate.

The iPad-sized book capture 10 retains readable fixed title/Pin controls, filters, external tabs/bookmark and separate footers. The selected title wraps cleanly; lower list and ingredient details use native leaf scrolling.

releaseOwnerFinalChecks.scope: Reported final local receipts; CI/public deployment and physical Safari certification are not claimed by this review

honestLimits: The inspected captures establish visible paper/fold and hierarchy improvements, not a pixel-identical recreation. The native paper fibre pattern is stronger and the single approved variant portrait differs from the concept's two distinct illustrations.

The original wave-31 concept contains two distinct variant illustrations. This implementation preserves one approved FRONT portrait and exact separate variant text rather than inventing or recoloring variant art.
Later explicit user requests continue to take precedence over older concept controls: removed search/help/legend and bottom wave navigation stay removed, while the recipe Pin action stays at the top.
Physical iPad Safari behavior is not established by desktop screenshots.

finalReview.notes: Native paper silhouette and continuous crease are visible. Final footers clear the curved rules by8 additional pixels. Tablet1180 uses25columns/tworows. Runtime uses one approved FRONT illustration per identity; no invented variant art.
